etymologies.etymologyHTML: P (upper case, lower case p, plural Ps or P's)

definitions.definition: (medicine) A P wave on an electrocardiogram.
(slang, chiefly US) Abbreviation of pure (A "pure" form of an illegal drug, especially heroin).

quote.citation: 2009, Dr Kerry Spackman, The Winner's Bible:
quote.text: P directly targets the dopamine pathways in your brain and as a result goes straight to your pleasure/reward module, which makes it an incredibly hard drug to break free from.

definitions.definition: (slang, New Zealand) Abbreviation of pure (A "pure" form of an illegal drug, especially methamphetamine).

quote.text: Almost 70kg of pre-cursor drugs that could be used to manufacture $20 million of P have been seized by police and customs officers.

definitions.definition: (UK, television) Initialism of product placement. (displayed on screen as an indicator to viewers)
An academic grade issued by certain educational institutions to indicate that a student passes a class.
(US, military, aviation) Initialism of patrol. A patrol aircraft, a patroller.

quote.text: They don't know 'bout the life that I live, / Man made bare Ps and buy new sticks

definitions.definition: (UK) Abbreviation of probationary (used on a vehicle's P-plate)
(Australia) Abbreviation of provisional (used on a vehicle's P-plate)
(chiefly US) Alternative spelling of P.M. (“post meridiem”) or PM
